content_law: Show three distinct people sharing one present environment.
The present organization must visibly carry evidence that an earlier human action materially changed one shared condition.
That changed condition must alter at least one person's present possibility, access, constraint, or relationship to another person.
The three people must not be interchangeable: each needs a distinct readable presence through posture, proportion, placement, carried condition, or another premise-compatible invariant.
Unequal access to what happened or what is available may be visible, but the image must not claim private knowledge, belief, memory, emotion, or intent.
Relationship must be carried by the scene's organization rather than labels, arrows, diagrams, captions, split panels, before/after framing, or interface graphics.
Invent unstated setting, era, objects, clothing and circumstance independently; no software/product/brand context.
output: one uninterrupted landscape artwork; no text, logo, border, presentation board, UI, diagram labels, or explanatory inset
